zh.background: NHGRI 為一般大眾與學生維護的遺傳學術語表。
zh.methods: 專家撰寫的術語定義，附語音說明與圖解。
zh.findings: 提供 DNA、RNA、gene、locus、allele、SNP、genotype、phenotype、exome、GWAS 等標準定義。
zh.limitations: 定義為入門層級，會持續更新；引用時記錄存取日期。

en.background: NHGRI's glossary of genetics terms for the public and students.
en.methods: Expert-written definitions with narration and illustrations.
en.findings: Standard definitions of DNA, RNA, gene, locus, allele, SNP, genotype, phenotype, exome and GWAS.
en.limitations: Introductory level and a living document; cite with access date.

zh.background: NIH 國家醫學圖書館的遺傳學入門指南。
zh.methods: 以問答方式解釋遺傳概念。
zh.findings: 區分 germline 與 somatic 變異；定義精準醫療並與一體適用方式對比。
zh.limitations: 面向一般大眾，深度有限。

en.background: NIH National Library of Medicine's genetics primer.
en.methods: Question-and-answer explanations.
en.findings: Distinguishes germline vs somatic variants; defines precision medicine versus one-size-fits-all.
en.limitations: Consumer level; limited depth.

zh.background: 人類基因體計畫後十年的定序技術回顧。
zh.methods: 比較短讀段與長讀段平台的原理、錯誤率與應用。
zh.findings: 成本下降、基因體數量增加；短讀段追求通量，長讀段解析結構複雜區域。
zh.limitations: 2016 年的技術現況，成本與通量數據已過時。

en.background: Review of a decade of sequencing after the Human Genome Project.
en.methods: Compares short- and long-read platforms: chemistry, error rates, applications.
en.findings: Falling cost and more genomes; short reads maximize throughput, long reads resolve complex regions.
en.limitations: State of the art as of 2016; cost/throughput figures are dated.

zh.background: 大型定序計畫需要通用的變異儲存格式。
zh.methods: 定義 VCF 規格並開發 VCFtools 軟體。
zh.findings: VCF 可儲存 SNP、indel、結構變異與註解，可壓縮與索引。
zh.limitations: 描述的是 VCF 4.x 早期版本；後續規格持續演進。

en.background: Large sequencing projects needed a common variant format.
en.methods: Defines the VCF specification and the VCFtools suite.
en.findings: VCF stores SNPs, indels, SVs and annotations; compressible and indexable.
en.limitations: Describes early VCF 4.x; the spec has evolved since.

zh.background: NGS 資料量龐大，分析工具開發困難。
zh.methods: 以 MapReduce 概念設計 GATK 程式框架。
zh.findings: 提供覆蓋度計算與 SNP calling 等工具，應用於 1000 Genomes 與 TCGA。
zh.limitations: 描述框架設計，非變異偵測準確度的基準比較。

en.background: NGS data volume made tool development hard.
en.methods: Designs the GATK framework on MapReduce principles.
en.findings: Provides coverage and SNP-calling tools used in 1000 Genomes and TCGA.
en.limitations: Describes framework design, not a calling-accuracy benchmark.

zh.background: 建立全球人類常見遺傳變異的參考資源。
zh.methods: 26 族群 2,504 人；低覆蓋 WGS、深度 WES 與晶片基因分型。
zh.findings: 超過 8,800 萬個變異並完成 phasing；涵蓋 >99% 頻率 >1% 的 SNP。
zh.limitations: 低覆蓋設計對罕見變異敏感度有限；族群涵蓋仍不完整。

en.background: A global reference of common human variation.
en.methods: 2,504 people from 26 populations; low-coverage WGS, deep WES and arrays.
en.findings: >88 million phased variants; >99% of SNPs with frequency >1%.
en.limitations: Low coverage limits rare-variant sensitivity; population coverage still incomplete.

zh.background: 舊參考基因體約 8% 未完成。
zh.methods: 以長讀段技術組裝 CHM13 細胞株基因體。
zh.findings: T2T-CHM13 共 30.55 億 bp，除 Y 外各染色體無缺口。
zh.limitations: 單一單倍體細胞株，不代表人類多樣性；不含 Y 染色體。

en.background: ~8% of the earlier reference was unfinished.
en.methods: Long-read assembly of the CHM13 cell line.
en.findings: T2T-CHM13: 3.055 Gbp, gapless except chromosome Y.
en.limitations: A single haploid line, not human diversity; no Y chromosome.

zh.background: 轉錄體分析從微陣列轉向定序。
zh.methods: 回顧 RNA-seq 原理、挑戰與早期應用。
zh.findings: RNA-seq 能更精確測量轉錄本與 isoform，改變對轉錄體複雜度的認識。
zh.limitations: 2009 年早期回顧，未涵蓋後續分析方法。

en.background: Transcriptomics moving from microarrays to sequencing.
en.methods: Reviews RNA-seq principles, challenges and early applications.
en.findings: More precise transcript/isoform measurement; changed views of transcriptome complexity.
en.limitations: Early (2009) review; predates later methods.

zh.background: RNA-seq 應用多樣，缺乏統一流程。
zh.methods: 回顧設計、QC、比對、定量、差異表現、剪接、功能分析與 eQTL。
zh.findings: 沒有適用所有情境的單一流程；讀段數需正規化才能跨樣本比較。
zh.limitations: 2016 年的工具與建議，部分已更新。

en.background: Diverse RNA-seq uses with no unified pipeline.
en.methods: Reviews design, QC, alignment, quantification, DE, splicing, functional analysis, eQTL.
en.findings: No single pipeline fits all; counts need normalization for cross-sample comparison.
en.limitations: Tools and advice as of 2016; some updated since.

zh.background: RPKM 廣泛用於表現量正規化。
zh.methods: 理論分析 RPKM 是否保持平均相對莫耳濃度不變。
zh.findings: RPKM 在樣本間不一致；提出 TPM。
zh.limitations: 理論論證；TPM 仍為相對量，不能直接用於差異檢定。

en.background: RPKM was widely used for normalization.
en.methods: Theoretical analysis of whether RPKM preserves average relative molar concentration.
en.findings: RPKM is inconsistent among samples; proposes TPM.
en.limitations: Theoretical; TPM is still relative and not a DE test by itself.

zh.background: 計數資料重複數少、離散且有離群值。
zh.methods: 負二項模型加上 dispersion 與 fold change 收縮估計。
zh.findings: DESeq2 提供更穩定、可解釋的差異表現估計。
zh.limitations: 假設多數基因非差異表現；極端設計需另行檢查。

en.background: Count data with few replicates, discreteness and outliers.
en.methods: Negative binomial model with shrinkage of dispersions and fold changes.
en.findings: DESeq2 gives stable, interpretable DE estimates.
en.limitations: Assumes most genes are not DE; unusual designs need checks.

zh.background: GWAS 方法學的系統性入門。
zh.methods: Nature Reviews Methods Primers 綜述：統計基礎、實施、限制與應用。
zh.findings: GWAS 檢定大量變異以找出統計關聯；結果用於生物學、遺傳率、風險預測、藥物開發與因果推論。
zh.limitations: 本專案僅取得摘要（OpenAlex），未能驗證全文細節。

en.background: Systematic primer on GWAS methodology.
en.methods: Nature Reviews Methods Primers: statistics, conduct, limitations, applications.
en.findings: GWAS test many variants for statistical association; uses span biology, heritability, risk prediction, drug development, causal inference.
en.limitations: Only the abstract (via OpenAlex) could be verified in this project.

zh.background: GWAS 實施十年的回顧。
zh.methods: 綜述族群遺傳、疾病生物學與轉譯成果。
zh.findings: 以 p < 5×10⁻⁸ 定義約 10,000 個強關聯；偵測力取決於樣本量、效應分布、頻率與 LD。
zh.limitations: 2017 年數據，關聯數量已大幅增加。

en.background: Ten years of GWAS reviewed.
en.methods: Review of population genetics, disease biology and translation.
en.findings: ~10,000 strong associations at p < 5×10⁻⁸; power depends on sample size, effect distribution, frequency and LD.
en.limitations: 2017 figures; association counts have grown greatly.

zh.background: LD 是族群遺傳與基因定位的核心概念。
zh.methods: 回顧 LD 定義、影響因素與應用。
zh.findings: LD 為不同基因座 allele 的非隨機關聯，受重組、天擇、漂變與突變影響。
zh.limitations: 理論回顧，不含現代大型生物資料庫的實證。

en.background: LD is central to population genetics and gene mapping.
en.methods: Reviews LD definitions, forces and uses.
en.findings: Nonrandom association of alleles at different loci, shaped by recombination, selection, drift, mutation.
en.limitations: Conceptual review; predates modern biobanks.

zh.background: GWAS 結果需要標準化整理與共享。
zh.methods: 描述 GWAS Catalog 的整理流程、提交入口與資料格式。
zh.findings: >45,000 篇 GWAS、>5,000 性狀、>40,000 組 summary statistics；連結 PGS Catalog。
zh.limitations: 數量為 2023 年快照；收錄依賴已發表研究。

en.background: GWAS results need standardized curation and sharing.
en.methods: Describes curation, submission portal and data format.
en.findings: >45,000 GWAS, >5,000 traits, >40,000 summary-statistics sets; linked to PGS Catalog.
en.limitations: 2023 snapshot; depends on published studies.

zh.background: PRS 分析缺乏一致指引，易誤解。
zh.methods: 教學指引：QC、計算方法、線上教學、常見誤解。
zh.findings: PRS 為效應量加權的風險 allele 總和；C+T 為標準方法；base/target 不可重疊。
zh.limitations: 以歐洲族群資料為主要範例。

en.background: PRS analyses lacked consistent guidance.
en.methods: Tutorial: QC, calculation methods, online tutorial, misconceptions.
en.findings: PRS = effect-weighted sum of risk alleles; C+T standard; base/target must not overlap.
en.limitations: Examples mainly use European-ancestry data.

zh.background: GWAS 初期對個人化預測期望很高。
zh.methods: 回顧 PRS 個人與臨床效用的證據。
zh.findings: 早期判斷幫助有限；近期證據支持群體層級的風險分層。
zh.limitations: 回顧文章；作者觀點偏向支持 PRS 應用。

en.background: High early expectations of GWAS for personal prediction.
en.methods: Reviews evidence for personal and clinical PRS utility.
en.findings: Early view: little use; recent evidence supports group-level stratification.
en.limitations: Review with a generally favourable stance.

zh.background: PRS 被期待用於精準醫療。
zh.methods: 跨族群分析 PRS 準確度與 GWAS 族群組成。
zh.findings: 目前 PRS 在歐洲血統中準確數倍；臨床使用可能擴大不平等。
zh.limitations: 觀點文章，結論基於現有 GWAS 組成。

en.background: PRS expected to advance precision medicine.
en.methods: Cross-ancestry analysis of PRS accuracy and GWAS composition.
en.findings: PRS several-fold more accurate in European ancestry; clinical use may widen disparities.
en.limitations: Perspective based on current GWAS composition.

zh.background: 已發表 PRS 難以重現與比較。
zh.methods: 建立 PGS Catalog 與標準化 metadata。
zh.findings: 公開評分檔與元資料，支援再現與獨立評估。
zh.limitations: 收錄品質依賴原始發表的完整度。

en.background: Published PRS were hard to reproduce and compare.
en.methods: Builds the PGS Catalog with standardized metadata.
en.findings: Open scoring files and metadata for reproducibility.
en.limitations: Quality depends on original publications.

zh.background: 臨床多聚焦於罕見單基因突變。
zh.methods: UK Biobank 英國血統；Phase I 選分數、Phase II 獨立測試。
zh.findings: 8.0%（CAD）至 1.5%（乳癌）人口風險 >3 倍；主張考慮納入臨床。
zh.limitations: 單一歐洲血統世代；相對風險；未評估臨床結果改善。

en.background: Clinical focus had been on rare monogenic mutations.
en.methods: UK Biobank British ancestry; Phase I selection, Phase II testing.
en.findings: 8.0% (CAD) to 1.5% (breast cancer) at >3-fold risk; proposes clinical consideration.
en.limitations: Single European cohort; relative risk; no outcome evaluation.

zh.background: 高通量技術產生多種體學資料。
zh.methods: 回顧各體學技術與整合策略。
zh.findings: 多體學可理解疾病資訊流；整合可由 genome、phenotype 或 environment 出發。
zh.limitations: 整合方法仍在發展，缺乏標準流程。

en.background: High-throughput tech yields many omics data types.
en.methods: Reviews omics technologies and integration strategies.
en.findings: Multi-omics reveals information flow; integration can start genome-, phenotype- or environment-first.
en.limitations: Integration methods still maturing; no standard pipeline.

zh.background: TCGA 累積多種腫瘤的分子資料。
zh.methods: Pan-Cancer 比較 12 種腫瘤的 DNA、RNA、蛋白、表觀資料。
zh.findings: 建立跨腫瘤的共通性與差異圖像。
zh.limitations: 計畫說明文章；跨癌種延伸療法為目標而非結果。

en.background: TCGA accumulated molecular data across tumours.
en.methods: Pan-Cancer compares DNA, RNA, protein, epigenetic data across 12 tumour types.
en.findings: Integrated picture of commonalities and differences.
en.limitations: Project description; cross-cancer therapy extension is an aim.

zh.background: 美國政府提出精準醫療計畫。
zh.methods: 政策觀點文章。
zh.findings: 近期聚焦癌症，長期擴及所有健康與疾病。
zh.limitations: 政策宣示，非研究結果。

en.background: US government launched a precision medicine initiative.
en.methods: Policy perspective.
en.findings: Near-term cancer focus; long-term all health and disease.
en.limitations: Policy statement, not research results.

zh.background: GWAS 參與者族群組成偏差。
zh.methods: 分析 GWAS Catalog 樣本族群組成（2016）。
zh.findings: 2009 年 96% 歐洲血統；2016 年非歐洲近 20%，以亞洲為主，非洲與拉丁美洲等 <4%。
zh.limitations: 評論文章；族群分類依原始研究自述。

en.background: Skewed ancestry of GWAS participants.
en.methods: Analysis of GWAS Catalog sample ancestry (2016).
en.findings: 96% European in 2009; ~20% non-European by 2016, mostly Asian; African, Latin American etc. <4%.
en.limitations: Comment piece; ancestry labels as self-reported by studies.

zh.background: NGS 臨床檢測增加變異判讀複雜度。
zh.methods: ACMG/AMP/CAP 工作小組專家共識。
zh.findings: 五級變異分類術語與證據準則；建議 CLIA 實驗室與認證專家判讀。
zh.limitations: 適用孟德爾疾病；不適用常見變異與 PRS。

en.background: Clinical NGS made variant interpretation complex.
en.methods: ACMG/AMP/CAP workgroup expert consensus.
en.findings: Five-tier terminology and evidence criteria; CLIA labs and certified interpretation.
en.limitations: For Mendelian disease; not for common variants or PRS.
